feeds.title: Trail Hiking Australia Blog
feeds.description: Be Safe & Prepared on Your Next Adventure. Check out the Trail Hiking Australia Hiking Blog. A resource filled with tips and tricks, information relating to skills, safety, trip preparation and navigation. Find out more about the gear you need for hiking as well as how to care for it effectively. All the resources you need for your next adventure.

feeds.title: Lotsafreshair Blog
feeds.description: Lotsafreshair is all about sharing tips, tricks and adventures in the great outdoors. Encouraging one another to get out into the freshair, maybe try something they haven't done before. The blog provides bushwalking and hiking tips from an unexpected outdoors chick, Caro Ryan.

feeds.title: The Ultralight Hiker
feeds.description: The Ultralight Hiker is all about light weight, ultra light hiking, backpacking, bushwalking, hunting, tracks, trails, adventures, gear and reviews. Sharing over sixty years experience of ultralight hiking & hunting in Australia & New Zealand.

feeds.title: Wild Magazine
feeds.description: Wild is Australia's longest running outdoor adventure magazine, with specialist content providing coverage and education for bushwalkers, backcountry and nordic skiiers, climbers, mountaineers and paddlers.Our mission is to inspire everyone to enjoy and value our wilderness places in a conscientious manner, and we do so by providing exciting feature stories, regular news updates and beautiful photography.

feeds.title: Hiking the World Blog
feeds.description: The Hiking the World blog combines my passion for hiking and photography. I'm not entirely sure if I hike in order to reach amazing places to photograph or take photos as a way of remembering and sharing my hiking experiences!

feeds.title: Summit Strength Blog
feeds.description: Summit Strength is a personal training service created specifically to help trekkers have the best chance of a safe, enjoyable and successful bucket list adventure.

feeds.title: The Bushwalking Blog
feeds.description: The Bushwalking Blog helps travel and outdoor enthusiasts find their perfect adventure, as well as the gear and knowledge they need to undertake it. We mostly explore the world on foot, but any outdoor adventure is a good adventure.

feeds.title: A Hikers Friend
feeds.description: The place for hikers! Guides, Reviews, Locations, photos, tips, lists, checklists, And more! The home of Australian hiking with an ever-growing community of hikers, you are bound to find what you are looking for and a bit more along the way!

feeds.title: Bike Hike Safari
feeds.description: Brad McCartney is an adventure Cyclist, Hiker and Nature Lover. His dream is to cycle and hike the most amazing places on the planet.He is a former Wilderness Guide, Police Officer, specialist in Youth Restorative Justice Programs, aspiring author and photographer. He hopes to inspire others to follow their dreams.

feeds.title: Hiking in Australia and New Zealand
feeds.description: The official site for New Zealand's biggest and most active online hiking community. Here you will find trip guides and reviews, gear tips and advice, food ideas and recipes, and a whole lot of other stuff related to hiking in Australia and New Zealand.

feeds.title: The Friends of the Heysen Trail
feeds.description: The 1200km hiking trail, the Heysen Trail, covers some of South Australia's most diverse and breathtaking landscapes, traversing coastal cliffs, beaches, native bushland, rugged gorges, pine forests and vineyards, as well as rich farmland and historic towns. Walk from Cape Jervis in the south to Parachilna Gorge in the Flinders Ranges, or hike from top to bottom.

feeds.title: Coffs Trails Blog
feeds.description: Covers stories and GPX data for hiking trails, dog walks, 4WD and adventure motorcycling trails on the glorious NSW coast from Port Macquarie and the Hastings, Macleay, Nambucca and Bellingen to the Coffs Coast and the Clarence Valley, and inland to the New England hinterland.
